en: This is a black-and-white (sepia-toned) aerial or elevated view of a town or suburb, showing numerous detached houses, gardens, fields, tree-lined streets, and a visible church with a steeple. The setting appears semi-rural with some signs of early industrialization (smoke from a chimney). In the upper left corner, there is red printed text 'Niederlößnitz-Kötzschenbroda.' The overall style and print suggest early 20th-century Europe.
